capabilities: correct spelling as you type via macOS NSSpellChecker and revert corrections
capitalize sentence, paragraph, list and heading starts automatically
insert a period when a word is followed by double-space
convert apostrophes and quotes to smart quotes
apply macOS Text Replacements while skipping code, math and links
extras: Native engine is macOS-only; other platforms fall back to the Electron spellchecker. Includes security/privacy disclosures (spawns osascript, optionally reads the Text Replacements database, no network use) and notes Vim mode interactions.
intentEvidence: Autocorrect as you type — something Electron apps famously can't do — powered by the real macOS autocorrect engine
problem: Electron-based apps like Obsidian cannot use the native macOS autocorrect engine while typing.

relations.evidence: it falls back to the Electron spellchecker's first suggestion

summary: Autocorrects spelling as you type using the native macOS spellchecker (NSSpellChecker), with auto-capitalization, double-space periods and smart quotes.
